description: Lists the livestock category slugs this API tracks (fed_cattle, feeder_cattle, cows, hogs, sheep) with display labels. Use to discover valid `product` values before calling get_livestock_price or get_livestock_history. Read-only; no API key. The list is the configured catalog, not a live availability check — some categories trade sporadically and can have no recent report in a region.
name: list_livestock_products
